subject: Invitation: ISV Interop Plugfest — LangWeave / Lindex / PromptWorks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@langweave.ai>, Daniel Chu <daniel@lindex.ai>, Terry Huang <terry@promptworks.co>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invitation: ISV Interop Plugfest — LangWeave / Lindex / PromptWorks

Hi Priya, Daniel, Terry —

Hope you’re all well. Redwood is running a small, hands-on interop "Plugfest" the week of Sept 13 to validate SDK-level compatibility across common ISV toolchains (LangWeave, Lindex, PromptWorks) and to surface lightweight tracing/telemetry hooks for our shared customers.

What we want to accomplish in a half-day slot with each partner:
- Confirm runtime compatibility with Redwood SDK (Python + Node) for core embed/generate flows
- Smoke test tracing hook that captures model_id + token latency without PII
- Validate a short compatibility matrix (prompt format, chat toolcall, retrieval pipeline)
- Capture a minimal remediation plan for any blocking gaps

We think a 3-hour hands-on session works best — 60m pairing, 60m automated tests in our sandbox, 30m go/no-go + next steps. I attached a draft agenda and an interop checklist.

Can you each confirm if your engineering lead can join one of these slots? Proposed dates: Sept 14 morning / Sept 15 afternoon / Sept 16 morning (PST).

Thanks — excited to move faster on this.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Engineering (Redwood Inference)
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-plugfest-agenda-2026-09-15.pdf, interop-compatibility-checklist.xlsx
From: Priya Reddy <priya@langweave.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: ISV Interop Plugfest — LangWeave / Lindex / PromptWorks

Vanessa —

Thanks for the invite. We’re keen to participate. I’ll bring our SDK engineer (Aman Kapoor) and our integrations PM. Sept 15 afternoon (PST) works best for us.

Two notes from our side:
1) We’d like to run an early quick check of the LangWeave->Redwood embedding path (we’ve seen tokenization edge-cases for multilingual prompts).
2) Can you confirm the tracing shim is privacy-preserving by default? We can share a short privacy checklist beforehand.

Happy to join a brief pre-call if that helps coordinate test accounts.

—Priya
Head of Platform Partnerships
LangWeave
priya@langweave.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@langweave.ai>, Daniel Chu <daniel@lindex.ai>, Terry Huang <terry@promptworks.co>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: ISV Interop Plugfest — LangWeave / Lindex / PromptWorks

Looping in logistics and test owners.

Vanessa — I can host the Redwood sandbox and provision transient API keys scoped to the "plugfest" role. Marcus, can you pick up the automated smoke test harness and add the two LangWeave edgecases Priya mentioned (multilingual tokenization + prompt-truncate behavior)? I’ll draft the privacy-preserving tracing shim spec and post it to the Drive link.

Tentative schedule (PST):
- 2026-09-15 13:00-16:00 — LangWeave pairing + tests
- 2026-09-16 09:00-12:00 — Lindex pairing + tests
- 2026-09-16 13:00-15:00 — PromptWorks quick validation

Action items:
- Vanessa: confirm final attendee list per partner (by EOD 9/3)
- Marcus: add multilingual tokenization test to harness (by 9/4)
- Priyom: upload tracing shim spec and minimal telemetry schema (by 9/4)

I'll also attach the transient-key onboarding playbook to the Drive folder once ready.

Thanks,
Priyom
Engineering Lead, Integrations (Redwood Inference)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@langweave.ai>, Daniel Chu <daniel@lindex.ai>, Terry Huang <terry@promptworks.co>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: ISV Interop Plugfest — LangWeave / Lindex / PromptWorks

Thanks all — confirming Sept 15 13:00-16:00 PST for LangWeave. Marcus, Priyom — please take the lead on the runbook and the interop checklist.

A couple of operational clarifications we committed to share with partners:
- Sandbox will enforce request quotas (transient keys) and will not persist any customer PII.
- Tracing shim will emit: model_id, token_counts, per-token latency buckets; no prompt text, no user identifiers.
- We will capture test-suite outputs to the shared Drive folder for post-mortem and next-step tickets.

Attachments: redwood-plugfest-agenda-2026-09-15.pdf (final), interop-compatibility-checklist.xlsx (v0.3)

Vanessa
